A {@creature bariaur wanderer|MPP} (see {@book Morte's Planar Parade|MPP}) wearing a gold monocle and an embroidered vest asks the characters to pick up an order for him at a nearby pawnshop. He offers to pay them 10 gp for their trouble (and their discretion).
Two {@creature Minotaure} smiths argue with a {@creature goristro} over the price of an expertly forged greataxe, turning to the characters to settle the debate.
An {@creature Athar null|MPP} (see {@book Morte's Planar Parade|MPP}) warmly greets the characters and offers to show them to their destination—while subtly pitching Athar philosophy to them.

The {@creature Spectre} of a factory worker appears to the characters and asks them to retrieve its skull from the {@book Bones of the Night|SatO|2|Bones of the Night} (see the "{@book Lower Ward Locations|SatO|2|Lower Ward Locations}" section) so it can finally be laid to rest.

Two {@creature Moine githzerai||githzerai monks} approach the characters, searching for a dangerous {@creature Slaad bleu} that stole a mote of primordial chaos from the {@book Face of Gith|SatO|2|Face of Gith} tavern (see the "{@book Lower Ward Locations|SatO|2|Lower Ward Locations}" section).

A soot-stained goblin {@creature mage} uses fire magic to repair a damaged {@creature Golem de fer} in the street. She tells the characters she needs two hundred pounds of iron to replace the construct's missing arm—even scrap will do.
A {@creature Transcendent Order instinct|MPP} (see {@book Morte's Planar Parade|MPP}) asks to spar with the characters, promising a reward if the character wins the fight.

A neutral good {@creature manticore} acupuncturist brushes past the characters, accidentally poking one of them with its spiny tail. As a token of apology, the manticore gifts the party a voucher for one free spa treatment at the Flame Pits (see the "{@book Market Ward Locations|SatO|2|Market Ward Locations}" section).
Wheeze Whistletooth, a {@creature Mégère nocturne} with a persistent hacking cough, offers the party free samples of her famous mystery meat pies.
Clearly troubled, a human {@creature Roturier} in the Free League asks the party which faction, if any, they believe is right about the truths of the multiverse.

A tiny copper soldier fashioned by a {@creature pentadrone} toymaker marches up to the party, salutes them, and then stops functioning.
A {@creature Géant des collines} stumbles toward the characters, pointing at his throat in worry but not saying a word. He's choking on an entire spit-roasted hog.
